dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Gradual 2D geometric narrowing of the visible body mass from the mid-dorsal region toward the posterior peduncle.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Slate dark-grey median pixel intensity across the visible dorsal area.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.transition_boundaries: Diffuse gradient slope observed at the margins of a centrally located lighter pigmented region.

high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.localized_point_contrast_disruptions: A single, distinct, light-toned oval patch is visible on the upper-central dorsal plane.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A prominent, depigmented mark or lesion is present on the central dorsal axis.
